description: Integrated Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Infrastructure Dataset (India) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abhigyan Pandey, Harsh Mishra (Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology). The dataset file contains geospatial locations of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations for several Indian citites, obtained by preprocessing, harmonizing and validating data from various sources mentioned here: Singh, P. (2025). EV charging stations in India – simplified (2025) [Data set]. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/pranjal9091/ev-charging-stations-in-india-simplified-2025 Government of India, Ministry of Power. (2025, March 28). Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
